about_the_game:
Enrich your game with live recorded, acoustic guitar music! Each of the 17 tracks were composed with influences from the JRPG composers to flamenco artists. This DLC was recorded with a Godin Multiac Deluxe guitar, and it is all composed and performed by Dr. B.A. Ferguson.

17 BGM
• 1 Introduction Cue
• 1 Menu Cue
• 4 Story Cues
• 2 Field Cues
• 3 Dungeon Cues
• 4 Town Cues
• 1 Shop Cue
• 1 Ending Cue

・This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
・OK to be used in Commercial projects made in RPG Maker
・You may modify some of the assets (but not redistribute them) for your own game use only.
